channel.title: The Weakest Link
channel.desc: Romesh Ranganathan is at the helm of one of the world's most iconic quizzes. The eight celebrities must initially work together to bank as much money as possible for charity before voting off one player per round as the weakest link. Only one player will be crowned the strongest link and take home the prize for their charity. The celebrity contestants in this episode are Dermot O'Leary, Charlene White, Lauren Layfield, Anthony Ogogo, Joe Baggs, Mark Heyes, Mhairi Black and Zeze Millz.
